title: Build Support Console panel
purpose: Give operators one place to inspect health, degraded state, audit evidence and support bundle export.
scope: Render support bundle readiness and last export path.
Render runtime health, audit status, ecosystem state and release evidence summary.
Expose typed support.bundle export action with preview.
Show remote audit mirror state without making it authoritative.
acceptance_criteria: Support Console can export bundle through typed command.
Support Console identifies degraded runtime or ecosystem state.
Support bundle manifest remains deterministic and redacted.
Remote mirror status is visible but local audit remains authority.
failure_modes: Support panel leaks raw secrets or raw prompt text.
Support export bypasses typed command dispatch.
Remote mirror state is treated as source of truth.
